text:
nina: Opening change window 03:30 UTC. Scope: router header flip (x-rd-routing -> split-v2) + runtime kernel_batched=true in canary. Need API pinned to v2.14.3 before flip. Canary plan: 5% 10m -> 50% 15m -> 100%.

carlos: Ack. Console PR ready with short note and rollback steps: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pull/4490

mei: pinned api to v2.14.3 in prod registry. Verified tag checksum.

deploybot: wave wb-612345-A created for api, router, runtime, console. Canary 5% for 10m.

nina: preflight: api pin ✅ console note ✅ runtime image pushed ✅ router flag staged ✅ dashboard live ✅ rollback runbook linked.

pager-bot: dashboard: https://obs.redwood/d/1200 - watching api 5xx, router header ratio, runtime restarts. Alerts to #eng-oncall.

carlos: runtime rolling to canary now. kubectl rollout status looks good.

deploybot: runtime rollout started (job rb-612345-rt). Canary nodes: 6.

mei: flipping router header on 5% canary. Quick curl health checks pass.

pager-bot: early metrics t+4m: api 5xx = 0.03% (baseline 0.03%), p95 +8ms. No alerts.

nina: keep canary 10m. Rollback triggers: api 5xx >0.5% sustained 5m OR p95 >30% increase OR >3 restarts in 10m.

carlos: progressing to 50% after stable window. Noted one transient 502 during router reconnection.

deploybot: wave wb-612345-A progressed to 50%.

pager-bot: aggregated t+20m: p95 +10ms, api 5xx 0.04%. Trend nominal.

mei: rolling final to 100% in 5m. Publishing short release note and emailing SRE/Support.

deploybot: rollout to 100% completed. wb-612345-A closed.

nina: post-rollout check t+40m: api 5xx 0.05%, p95 +9ms, no incidents. Closing window.
